summary_1line: Bhishma explains to Yudhishthira that Truth is the supreme duty, manifesting in thirteen virtues such as impartiality, self‑control, compassion, and non‑injury.

image_candidates.scene_text: Truth is placed on a balance scale opposite a thousand horse-sacrifices and weighs heavier than them all.
The aged Bhishma, lying on his bed of arrows, instructs the attentive Yudhishthira about the many forms of Truth.
